```{r load-libraries, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#--------------------------
# Load Libraries
#--------------------------
library(Signac)
library(Seurat)
library(patchwork)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(future)
library(ggplot2)
library(AnnotationHub)
library(BSgenome.Ggallus.UCSC.galGal6)
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)
library(htmlwidgets)
library(GenomeInfoDb)
```

## 1. Annotation Reference and Genome Setup

```{r annotation-genome-setup}
#Reference for label tranfer
labelobjectdir <- "C:/Users/jacwe/Downloads/SAMAP/rna_Jack.rds"
reference_obj <- readRDS(labelobjectdir)
if (!"celltype" %in% colnames(reference_obj@meta.data)) {
  reference_obj$celltype <- Idents(reference_obj)  # uses active.ident
}

# Retrieve annotation from AnnotationHub for Gallus gallus
ah <- AnnotationHub()
# Query for Gallus gallus gene annotation from Ensembl
gg_ensdb_query <- query(ah, c("Gallus gallus", "Ensembl", "113", "GRCg7b"))

#select the first result
gg_ensdb <- gg_ensdb_query[[1]]
annotation <- GetGRangesFromEnsDb(ensdb = gg_ensdb)

# Set genome and standardize sequence naming (using UCSC style)
genome(annotation) <- "galGal6"
```

## 2. Create RNA Objects for Each Sample

```{r create-rna-objects}
# Sample SS RNA
ss_rna_counts <- Read10X_h5("C:/Users/jacwe/Downloads/SAMAP/SS/filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5")
ss <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = ss_rna_counts, assay = "RNA")
ss$sample <- "SS"

# Sample NM RNA
nm_rna_counts <- Read10X_h5("C:/Users/jacwe/Downloads/SAMAP/NM/filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5")
nm <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = nm_rna_counts, assay = "RNA")
nm$sample <- "NM"
```

## 3. Create ATAC Objects

```{r create-atac-objects}
# Sample SS ATAC
ss_atac_counts <- Read10X_h5("C:/Users/jacwe/Downloads/SAMAP/SS/filtered_peak_bc_matrix.h5")
ss_atac_assay <- CreateChromatinAssay(
  counts = ss_atac_counts,
  sep = c(":", "-"),
  genome = "galGal6",
  fragments = "C:/Users/jacwe/Downloads/SAMAP/SS/fragments.tsv.gz",
  annotation = annotation
)
ss_atac <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = ss_atac_assay, assay = "ATAC")
ss_atac$sample <- "SS"

# Sample NM ATAC
nm_atac_counts <- Read10X_h5("C:/Users/jacwe/Downloads/SAMAP/NM/filtered_peak_bc_matrix.h5")
nm_atac_assay <- CreateChromatinAssay(
  counts = nm_atac_counts,
  sep = c(":", "-"),
  genome = "galGal6",
  fragments = "C:/Users/jacwe/Downloads/SAMAP/NM/fragments.tsv.gz",
  annotation = annotation
)
nm_atac <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = nm_atac_assay, assay = "ATAC")
nm_atac$sample <- "NM"

atac_list <- list(ss_atac, nm_atac)
```

## 4. Integrate RNA Samples Together

```{r integrate-rna-data}
# Process each RNA object individually
rna_list <- list(ss, nm)
for (i in seq_along(rna_list)) {
  rna_list[[i]] <- NormalizeData(rna_list[[i]])
  rna_list[[i]] <- FindVariableFeatures(rna_list[[i]])
}

# Merge RNA objects and process the merged object
rna <- merge(ss, nm, add.cell.ids = c("SS", "NM"))
DefaultAssay(rna) <- "RNA"
rna <- NormalizeData(rna)
rna <- ScaleData(rna)
rna <- FindVariableFeatures(rna)
rna <- RunPCA(rna, npcs = 100)
ElbowPlot(rna, ndims = 50)
rna <- RunUMAP(rna, dims = 1:15)
rna <- FindNeighbors(rna, dims = 1:30)
rna <- FindClusters(rna, resolution = 0.5)
rna$seurat_clusters <- Idents(rna)
```

## 5. Transfer Labels from Reference to RNA object

```{r transfer-labels-rna}
transfer_anchors <- FindTransferAnchors(
  reference = reference_obj,
  query = rna,
  dims = 1:30
)
predicted_labels <- TransferData(
  anchorset = transfer_anchors,
  refdata = reference_obj$celltype,
  dims = 1:30
)
rna$predicted_celltype <- predicted_labels$predicted.id

#Check prediction confidence scores
print(head(predicted_labels$prediction.score.max))

#assign cell type and modality labels in RNA
rna$celltype <- rna$predicted_celltype
rna$modality <- "RNA"
```

## 6. Process ATAC Data, Create Common Peak Set, Remove Bad Cluster

```{r process-atac-common-peaks}
# Process each individual ATAC object with TF-IDF, top features, and SVD (using "rlsi" as reduction name)
for (i in seq_along(atac_list)) {
  DefaultAssay(atac_list[[i]]) <- "ATAC"
  atac_list[[i]] <- RunTFIDF(atac_list[[i]])
  atac_list[[i]] <- FindTopFeatures(atac_list[[i]], min.cutoff = 'q0')
  atac_list[[i]] <- RunSVD(atac_list[[i]], reduction.name = "rlsi", n = 30)
}

# Create a unified (common) peak set from both ATAC samples
ss_peaks <- StringToGRanges(rownames(ss_atac))
nm_peaks <- StringToGRanges(rownames(nm_atac))
combined_peak_set <- reduce(c(ss_peaks, nm_peaks))
peak_widths <- width(combined_peak_set)
combined_peak_set <- combined_peak_set[peak_widths < 10000 & peak_widths > 20]

# Standardize sequence level styles for the peak ranges
seqlevelsStyle(ss_atac_assay@ranges) <- "UCSC"
seqlevelsStyle(nm_atac_assay@ranges) <- "UCSC"

# Merge ATAC objects (merging without filtering QC first)
atac <- merge(ss_atac, y = nm_atac, add.cell.ids = c("SS", "NM"))

# Re-quantify reads over the unified peak set
common_counts <- FeatureMatrix(
  fragments = Fragments(atac),
  features = combined_peak_set,
  cells = colnames(atac)
)
atac_merged_assay <- CreateChromatinAssay(
  counts = common_counts,
  fragments = Fragments(atac),
  genome = "galGal6",
  annotation = annotation
)
atac <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = atac_merged_assay, assay = "ATAC")
atac$sample <- sapply(strsplit(colnames(atac), "_"), `[`, 1)

# Process the merged ATAC object: TF-IDF, top features, and SVD (using reduction name "lsi")
atac <- RunTFIDF(atac)
atac <- FindTopFeatures(atac, min.cutoff = 'q0')
atac <- RunSVD(atac, reduction.name = "lsi", n = 30)
DepthCor(atac)

# Run UMAP on the merged ATAC object using the LSI reduction
atac <- RunUMAP(atac, reduction = "lsi", dims = 1:30, reduction.key = "atacUMAP_")
atac <- FindNeighbors(atac, reduction = "lsi", dims = 1:30)
atac <- FindClusters(atac, resolution = 0.1)

# Subset out cluster "0", bad quality cells
atac <- subset(atac, idents = setdiff(unique(Idents(atac)), "0"))

#re-run dimensional reduction on filtered data
atac <- RunTFIDF(atac)
atac <- FindTopFeatures(atac, min.cutoff = 'q0')
atac <- RunSVD(atac, reduction.name = "lsi", n = 30)
atac <- RunUMAP(atac, reduction = "lsi", dims = 1:30)
atac <- FindNeighbors(atac, reduction = "lsi", dims = 1:30)
atac <- FindClusters(atac, resolution = 0.1)
```

## 7. Apply QC on Merged ATAC and Generate UMAP Heatmaps

```{r qc-and-umap-heatmaps}
DefaultAssay(atac) <- "ATAC"

# Compute nucleosome signal and TSS enrichment on the merged object
atac <- NucleosomeSignal(atac)
atac <- TSSEnrichment(atac)

atac <- subset(
  atac,
  subset = nCount_ATAC > 500 &
    TSS.enrichment > 3 &
    nucleosome_signal < 2
)

message("Merged ATAC object after QC has ", ncol(atac), " cells")

# After subsetting, re-run TF-IDF, SVD, and UMAP if needed.
if (!"lsi" %in% names(atac@reductions)) {
  atac <- RunTFIDF(atac)
  atac <- FindTopFeatures(atac, min.cutoff = 'q0')
  atac <- RunSVD(atac, reduction.name = "lsi", n = 30)
}
if (!"umap" %in% names(atac@reductions)) {
  atac <- RunUMAP(atac, reduction = "lsi", dims = 1:30, reduction.key = "atacUMAP_")
}

# Generate UMAP heatmap for nucleosome_signal using FeaturePlot
p_nucleosome_umap <- FeaturePlot(
  atac,
  features = "nucleosome_signal",
  reduction = "umap"
) + ggtitle("UMAP Heatmap: Nucleosome Signal (Merged ATAC, Post-QC)")

# Generate UMAP heatmap for nCount_ATAC using FeaturePlot
p_nCount_umap <- FeaturePlot(
  atac,
  features = "nCount_ATAC",
  reduction = "umap"
) + ggtitle("UMAP Heatmap: nCount_ATAC (Merged ATAC, Post-QC)")

# Convert the ggplot heatmaps to interactive Plotly objects
plotly_nucleosome_umap <- ggplotly(p_nucleosome_umap)
plotly_nCount_umap <- ggplotly(p_nCount_umap)

plotly_nucleosome_umap
plotly_nCount_umap

# Save the interactive plots as HTML widgets
htmlwidgets::saveWidget(plotly_nucleosome_umap, "UMAP_Nucleosome_Signal_Merged_ATAC_PostQC.html")
htmlwidgets::saveWidget(plotly_nCount_umap, "UMAP_nCountATAC_Merged_ATAC_PostQC.html")
```

## 8. Transfer RNA Labels to ATAC via Gene Activity

```{r transfer-rna-to-atac}
# Compute gene activities for ATAC using RNA variable features
gene.activities <- GeneActivity(atac, features = VariableFeatures(reference_obj))
atac[["ACTIVITY"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = gene.activities)

# Normalize and scale the ACTIVITY assay
DefaultAssay(atac) <- "ACTIVITY"
atac <- NormalizeData(atac)
atac <- ScaleData(atac, features = rownames(atac))

atac <- FindVariableFeatures(atac)
atac <- RunPCA(atac, assay = "ACTIVITY", reduction.name = "activity_pca")

# Find transfer anchors between RNA (RNA assay) and ATAC (ACTIVITY assay)
transfer.anchors <- FindTransferAnchors(
  reference = rna,
  query = atac,
  features = VariableFeatures(object = rna),
  reference.assay = "RNA",
  query.assay = "ACTIVITY",
  reduction = "cca"
)

# Use the gene activity PCA reduction for weighting in TransferData
celltype.predictions <- TransferData(
  anchorset = transfer.anchors,
  refdata = rna$predicted_celltype,  # using RNA predicted cell types
  weight.reduction = atac[["lsi"]],
  dims = 2:30
)
atac <- AddMetaData(atac, metadata = celltype.predictions)

print(head(celltype.predictions$prediction.score.max))

atac$celltype <- atac$predicted.id
atac$modality <- "ATAC"
```

## 9. Save RNA and ATAC Objects Before Integration

```{r save-objects}
saveRDS(rna, file = "rna_prePlot.rds")
saveRDS(atac, file = "atac_prePlot.rds")
```

## 10. Plotting RNA and ATAC UMAPs

```{r plotting-umaps}
# Plot 1: RNA UMAP colored by cell type
p_rna_celltype <- DimPlot(rna, reduction = "umap", group.by = "predicted_celltype", label = TRUE) +
  ggtitle("RNA UMAP: Labeled by Cell Type")
plotly_rna_celltype <- ggplotly(p_rna_celltype)
htmlwidgets::saveWidget(plotly_rna_celltype, "RNA_CellType.html")

plotly_rna_celltype

# Plot 2: ATAC UMAP colored by cell type (using predicted.id)
p_atac_celltype <- DimPlot(atac, reduction = "umap", group.by = "predicted.id", label = TRUE) +
  ggtitle("ATAC UMAP: Labeled by Cell Type")
plotly_atac_celltype <- ggplotly(p_atac_celltype)
htmlwidgets::saveWidget(plotly_atac_celltype, "ATAC_CellType.html")

plotly_atac_celltype

# Plot 3: ATAC UMAP colored by sample
p_atac_sample <- DimPlot(atac, reduction = "umap", group.by = "sample", label = TRUE) +
  ggtitle("ATAC UMAP: Labeled by Sample")
plotly_atac_sample <- ggplotly(p_atac_sample)
htmlwidgets::saveWidget(plotly_atac_sample, "ATAC_Sample.html")

plotly_atac_sample
```
